verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking platform, and a natural-language command interface such as an AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of one, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes app menus, automated rules and integrations, with no conversational or natural-language operation. The llms.txt probe makes support docs readable by LLMs but does not let users operate the product through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
